tool_block_rule: A tool safety block is recorded as blocked_generation and receives no pixel score.

hard_gates.pass_condition: A finite intact barrier visibly surrounds one fresh breach.
One subject, object, or force aligns directly with the localized rupture point.
Fresh cracks, tearing, shear, or deformation radiate from that same contact.
A new aperture and coherent crossing through the former boundary are both visible.
Displaced material and aftermath stay localized along the contact-to-passage path.
The reference-guided adult visibly retains long center-parted dark wavy hair, dark eyes, softly arched brows, adult impression, and broadly comparable face proportions.
The appearance-guided subject remains visible without obscuring the physical breakthrough relation.
Barrier, force direction, fresh aperture, and crossing remain readable together.
Contact-point rupture, intact surrounding material, and localized displacement remain separately inspectable.
No unintended watermark or scene-breaking accidental text is visible.

overall_pass_condition: Every hard gate passes. Any partial, ambiguous, or failed gate makes the arm fail.
